label: B25-BRAM-MONITOR
title: Initialize the 64 KiB M20K boot RAM and add a resident AArch64 monitor
write_regions: fpga/catapult_a10/rtl/lcvex_catapult_a10_top.sv::BRAM_BYTES and BOOT initialization parameter block only
forbidden_regions: clock generator/Qsys clock wiring owned by T-038
shared QSF/manifests/test registry, QEMU, Flash/JIC and board actions
scope: Use one AArch64 ELF to generate byte HEX and WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192 little-endian MIF, initialize the synthesis M20K, move the stack below 0x10000, and run a BRAM-resident polling monitor that never jumps into uninitialized DDR.

firmware_contract.availability: READY and serial polling must remain reachable after calibration failure or timeout

validation: Check ELF sections/stack/image size, HEX/MIF byte identity, reset-vector content, special calibration paths, DDR write/readback and polling command behavior in focused simulation.
acceptance: BRAM is exactly [0,0x10000), stack is [0xF000,0x10000), Quartus power-up data is deterministic, and the monitor can diagnose UART even when DDR is unavailable.
resource: Lane runs only lightweight build/static/focused checks; parent owns heavy SoC validation.

result.status: accepted; parent boot build, MIF checker, BRAM init/legacy tests and B25 SoC smoke pass
